title: Car Rental Without Credit Card: Thrifty Holds and Card Acceptance
answer: A general debit-card statement does not confirm that your specific card and booking qualify. Thrifty’s published U.S. policy allows an authorization hold of up to $200.00 for credit cards or $500 for debit cards in addition to the estimated rental charges, subject to its listed exceptions; this is a hold, not a charge or penalty, and does not itself mean your card will be refused.
html:
A hold is different from a refusal

The credit-card and debit-card amounts are separate tiers of Thrifty’s published U.S. authorization policy. Both are in addition to estimated rental charges, and the policy’s listed exceptions still apply. A hold is not a penalty for using debit.

Does a Revolut explanation establish the rule?

A commenter’s explanation does not establish your card’s classification or the reason it was refused.

Keep the individual refusal separate from a company-wide rule. The LAX account below describes a refusal involving Revolut; that account does not establish that every Revolut card is classified or treated the same way.

The individual account

A poster described being refused a car at LAX and recorded as a no-show. This is the poster’s account, not a booking or pickup performed by this site.

Read the LAX card-refusal account in r/Revolut. Post title: Denied rental car pickup @LAX Airport solely because my card is "Revolut" (even though they accept Debit). Has anyone successfully disputed this?
